svg.title: World map: The Realms (sample data)
svg.desc: Sample data. Sample Player, level 10, rank Warden II. You are at River of Reviews. Next: reach level 20 to unlock Citadel of Releases. 2% of the way to the next region's level gate. Main path, bottom to top: Starter Village completed, 3 of 3; Forest of Branches completed, 3 of 3; River of Reviews: current region, 2 of 3; Citadel of Releases locked until level 20; Peaks of Mastery locked until level 35; Throne of Eternity locked until level 50. Domain regions: Lantern Spires 1 of 3; Iron Forge 1 of 3; Twin Bridges 1 of 3; Observatory of Patterns 1 of 3; Harbor of Pipelines 1 of 3; Open Commons 1 of 3.
